content: Mishat, tsapurunasingaz maachirita nda támaramaam wanichintspa
¿Mayaamsha mantsir taaksa? ¿Mayaama warataksa? ¿Ndusha maachtangazim támarakus ashkis? Ashkachus, yutaritshish siyaa aranginasha kasikiya.

Kapung maachtangaz támarakus, itaru saana yamaam pinasakus, yutarit tsiyatkus, warataksa. Maachtangaz yapi átus tputsee pachaksa. ¿Antaati ashkis an wanasireeja? ¿Saantari Apanllee nda mashkus ashkatasa?
Mashkitaatis, itaru Apanll siyaam nda panakiya; watam ngutaritis msangeerus mashaksawa. Yuwaa támarakis anoo yáyarus, ngutaritis ungareem payupi átus mashaksawa.
Siy kaapa itsinsaru nda chinaksa. Yutaritshishee chinakuch, uru Apanllee ndusha chinaksa. Chiy yutaritshishee patsisapi átuch, Apanlleem undarari kinachchi.
Nitaati Apanll kuk mangu átareeja; Tputsirishi nuwaanaatsi kani mangush pshtaranguri, ashiri anoo tputsireetsi pachindaktana, nuwaanaatstamari chinapanda aturi; tárangiya Apanlli.

Ashiriya, Apanlleetsimari chinakinaareesa ashiru, Apanll siyaa istachapantsa; watam waana kuk, táranguwa. Yuw tputs nuwaanaatsi chinakana anoo kizpur istachima, itaru yuwaatssha nda nuwaanaatsi chinakana anoo wanichima; tárangiya Apanlli.
Ashiriya, paptsa; izuureerus Apanllee chinangtsa. Yashingoo ngatkus, Watsta, watsta, ántar ashkinaareesa ashiru, Yashingsha suwachparee.
Apanllingaz zandkus, Apanllsha siyaa istachintsa. Yutaritshishpanis, Apanllimun mangeetsis tchingangtsa. Mangishis sarichkus, Apaa, mangeetsi yaranganda tángtsa.

Apanllingaz zandkus, mangis mantsayarus, tanungtsa. Sirú yutarit zarungchamamari chinarangus kapung statarsa. Itaru, na tanumaam waritakiya. Sirú yutaritshishee michitarangsa. Itaru, na nimun kapung mangis mantsakinaareesa ashiru;
Apaa, nuw yutarittana, tángtsa. Atinaareesa ashiru, Apanllsha kizpur istachintsa siyaatsiya. Ashirucha, yutaritshishee chinarintspa atashina.
Mishat, zuwanllee, saanpata yutarit tsiyatintspa. Chiy Isuschichee yutarit tsiyatkuch, ashiritam Apanlleetstam kuk yutaritam ínakchi. Ashkuch, chaanasha nduntam Apanllee kuk wanasiri payukchi.

Apanllimari waana chiyaa yasariya, watam waana kamachtakuwa. Waanari chiy wámachtashee tuminkuch, uwsha chiyaa tapachindachtamparee. Itaru, chiy wámachtashee kapeetkinaareechi ashiru, uwsha chiyaa wanichtamparee. Itaru, chiy tputsee yutarita tsiyatkuch, ¿antaati chiy Apanllchiwa tputsee taárash yasaruch tsiyatpich; watam Apanll waana kamachtaranguwa? Ashirucha,: Isuschicheewaa tputs yutarit tsiyatintspa; siyaa atashina.

Na urkirpanis mazinangtsa; nuw siyaa waneekuri táchintspa. ¿Mayaamsha shiy: Pu tuwash naachparina. Anush yaktash minam masach taayaruri, maachi zapan paxanxkachuri, kurikee zapan putachparina; ántar ashiksha?

¿Pu tamachinda átush átsha? Wapaz ndatuma iwapambarush tsipakchush, ¿tamacheezish shiya? Watam tputsich msas tamapari ashitichcha. Napa msas natumari yakatara sheeru, musásirisha tsípatara ashishtar ashkiya. Chiy tputsich tsipanich ashiritamcha.
Ashiriya, itsinsarush tsiyatangcha. Apanll waana zandku, nduniya tsipakuri, yuw zandki anoo ashtachparina; tángcha.
Nda átush itaru zapanna tsiyatkush, ¿ndusha kukish zapanimashish? Anumash yutaritanda.
Ashirucha, wanasiri taamaam yasayaritaatich, itaru nda ashiru taakuch, kaapanasha Apanllee kuk kapeetakchi. Ashirucha, minamari k'kuz payungtsa tina.
